display.purpose: The workbench title and the wordmark; appears once per surface.

headline.purpose: Section titles; always stand alone with nothing adjacent.

body.purpose: Prose, controls, schedule and method text.

label.purpose: Uppercase field labels and table headers.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Native control transitions only; the workbench animates nothing of its own.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The only button style: bordered, near-square, raised paper, forest wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #2b2417; background: #faf6ea; border: 1px solid #b3a486; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.42rem 0.8rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: #2e5c38; color: #1e4026; background: rgba(46,92,56,0.16); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #1f5fae; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn[disabled] { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Select Input
components.description: Native select on raised paper with the strong hairline rule.
components.css: .ds-select { font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; color: #2b2417; background: #faf6ea; border: 1px solid #b3a486; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.42rem 0.55rem; width: 100%; } .ds-select:hover { border-color: #2e5c38; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #1f5fae; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field Label
components.description: Small uppercase label that sits above every control.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="quota">Water quota for the week</label>
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5d5340; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Single hairline strip: serif wordmark left, quiet action links and buttons right.
components.html:
CropPulse
Field schedule
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #b3a486; background: #faf6ea; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1e4026; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-nav a { color: #2b2417; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #b3a486; padding: 0.2rem 0.1rem; font-size: 0.92rem; } .ds-nav a:hover { border-bottom-color: #2e5c38; color: #1e4026; } .ds-nav button { font: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #2b2417; background: #faf6ea; border: 1px solid #b3a486; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.42rem 0.8rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav button:hover { border-color: #2e5c38; color: #1e4026; background: rgba(46,92,56,0.16); }

components.name: Ledger Table
components.description: Hairline ruled data table: uppercase head, row-header first column, tabular numerals.
components.html:
MeasureFixed calendarOptimized
Water pumped126 m3108 m3
Critical plot-days63
components.css: .ds-ledger { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #2b2417; background: #f4eee0; } .ds-ledger th, .ds-ledger td { text-align: left; padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem 0.4rem 0; border-top: 1px solid #d8cdb4; vertical-align: baseline; font-weight: 400; } .ds-ledger thead th { border-top: 0; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #b3a486; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5d5340; padding-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-ledger .num { text-align: right; }

components.name: Plot Card
components.description: Bordered button-card that selects a plot; selected state is the forest wash plus a 2px border.
components.css: .ds-plot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; text-align: left; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #2b2417; background: #faf6ea; border: 1px solid #b3a486; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.85rem 0.95rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-plot:hover { border-color: #2e5c38; } .ds-plot[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #2e5c38; border-width: 2px; padding: calc(0.85rem - 1px) calc(0.95rem - 1px); background: rgba(46,92,56,0.16); } .ds-plot:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #1f5fae; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-plot-name { font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.02rem; } .ds-plot-meta { font-size: 0.8rem; color: #5d5340; } .ds-plot-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.6rem; font-size: 0.82rem; border-top: 1px solid #d8cdb4; padding-top: 0.3rem; margin-top: 0.15rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Comparison Bar Pair
components.description: Shaded before/after bars: terracotta outline for the calendar, forest fill for the optimized plan.
components.html: <svg class="ds-bars" viewBox="0 0 72 14" aria-hidden="true"><rect class="cal" x="0" y="1" width="58" height="5"/><rect class="opt" x="0" y="8" width="68" height="5"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-bars { display: block; width: 72px; height: 14px; } .ds-bars .opt { fill: #2e5c38; } .ds-bars .cal { fill: none; stroke: #a8523a; stroke-width: 1.2; }

components.name: Synthetic Data Label
components.description: The honesty label that closes the settings column; amber-ringed dot, ink-soft text.
components.html: Synthetic demonstration data. No field sensors and no local agronomist review.
components.css: .ds-synthetic { border-top: 1px solid #d8cdb4; padding: 0.9rem 0 0; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #5d5340; margin: 0; } .ds-synthetic::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; border: 1.5px solid #8f6d1c; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 0.5rem; vertical-align: -0.05em; }

narrative.overview: CropPulse looks like the ruled notebook a grower keeps next to the pump log: warm ivory paper, hairline row rules, and two ink colors that never blur together, forest green for the optimized plan and muted terracotta for the fixed calendar. The layout is a code-led workbench, not a marketing page: a settings column on the left, one dominant water-depletion figure on the right, a ledger of plan differences, then the weekly schedule and the method notes. Everything earns its rule. There are no decorative cards, no illustration, no pills; separation comes from hairlines and spacing. Data numerals are tabular, axes are labeled, and every surface states plainly that the data is synthetic.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory paper ground with hairline ledger rules
Two data inks: forest green (optimized), terracotta (fixed calendar)
Expressive serif display face, quiet sans for everything else
One authored chart per plot, dense and gridded like a chart of record
Focus is always visible; every interactive element is a native control

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Data is forest or terracotta and never a third hue. Amber and sienna mark thresholds only; they never carry a data series.

rules.name: The Title Stands Alone Rule
rules.body: No heading in the app carries a kicker above it or a caption beneath it. Context notes live at the bottom of panels.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from row-rule hairlines and rule-strong borders at 1 to 2px. No drop shadows anywhere.

dos: Do keep every numeric column in tabular numerals and right-aligned.
Do label every data surface synthetic and unreviewed; place the label at the bottom of the panel, never under a title.
Do use the forest wash plus border for selection; hover changes border and wash, never shadow.
Do keep UTC on every time shown in the schedule.
donts: Don't add eyebrows, taglines, or helper lines adjacent to a heading.
Don't use pills, rounded cards, gradient text, or shadows.
Don't gray out secondary text to plain gray; use ink-soft so it stays inside the warm family.
Don't let amber or sienna carry a data series; they are thresholds.
